title: Galaxy Watch 8 Prime Day deal drops it to within $4 of its all-time low
summary: The Galaxy Watch 8 40mm LTE drops to $269.99 for Prime Day, with phone-free calls, messages, and Samsung health tracking.
body: Amazon has dropped the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 (40mm, LTE) to $269.99 , down from its $349.99 recommended retail price. That saves you $80, a 23% discount off the RRP, and makes this Prime Day offer the best price we’ve seen on Samsung’s small LTE smartwatch since the last Prime Day sale. Even then, it was only $4 cheaper! See the deal at Amazon

title: Samsung’s premium Galaxy Watch 8 Classic is down to $389.99 at Amazon
summary: Save 28% on the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 Classic, a premium Wear OS smartwatch with a rotating bezel and health tools.
body: The Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 Classic is Samsung’s premium classic-style smartwatch for 2025, and it brings back one of the features many watch fans still love: the rotating bezel. There’s also a solid deal on it at Amazon right now, which makes this a good time to take a closer look. See the deal at Amazon

title: Smartwatches are struggling to connect with Strava (Updated: Statement)
summary: A smartwatch-to-Strava glitch is frustrating the fitness community.
body: Credit: Kaitlyn Cimino / Android Authority TL;DR Strava is reportedly having trouble syncing with smartwatches. Users are experiencing the issue on Galaxy, Garmin, and Apple devices. It’s unclear what the cause of the issue is. Update, October 6, 2026 (03:28 AM ET): A Strava spokesperson has shared the following statement with us on the issue: The issues noted are isolated and disconnected from one another. While we work with each of our device partners to make integration with Strava as smooth as possible, every ecosystem has a slightly different integration, so issues occasionally occur.
